name: Materials Science & Engr (PMn)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc: The university’s basic requirements for the PhD minor are outlined in Graduate Degrees. A minor requires 20 units of quality and depth graduate work at the 201 level or higher in the Materials Science and Engineering course offering subject code. Courses must be taken for a letter grade. The department’s advanced degree committee must approve the proposed list of courses. Individual programs must be submitted to the Student Services Director at least one quarter before the quarter of the degree conferral. None of the units taken for the PhD minor may overlap with any MS degree units.

rules.name: 20 units of MATSCI courses numbered 201 or higher
Course list approved by the advanced degree committee
No units shared with an MS degree
Cumulative GPA of 3.0 for PhD minor courses

gpa: Cumulative GPA for all PhD minor courses must be at least 3.0
grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade. The minimum grade in each course is a C. Students with a C- or below must re-take the course to confer the degree.
transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks 20 units of MATSCI courses numbered 201 or higher, each letter graded with a C or better (research, colloquium, teaching and other courses offered only satisfactory/no credit do not count). Checked by hand: the advanced degree committee approves your course list, the 3.0 GPA, and that none of these units also count toward an MS degree.
